system.description:
The Sidereal activates this Charm with a prayer strip bearing the Scripture of the Maiden's Promise. The prayer strip rises into the air and hovers near him, dragging trails of violet light in its wake. By that light, and in the name of the Violet Bier of Sorrows, the Sidereal makes a binding vow to accomplish some important goal. The vow forges a sorcerous Intimacy toward that goal—one that cannot be eroded normally while the Charm persists. His name and very identity are pledged as collateral.

While under this Charm's effects, the character's Arcane Fate becomes universal: even Sidereals and beings outside of fate forget him, with all attempts to remember him suffering a −3 internal penalty on top of any other modifiers. He suffers a −2 internal penalty on rolls for actions unrelated to his goal, and a −5 internal penalty on rolls directly contrary to it. All rolls that further the sworn goal gain one automatic success, and the character ignores wound and fatigue penalties when working toward that goal. Stunt dice earned on goal-furthering rolls convert to automatic successes; after any such roll the character heals one lethal or all bashing health levels as the Maiden's reward.

If the Sidereal completes his goal, his name and identity return. If the prayer strip is destroyed or the Charm ends prematurely—whether by choice or necessity—his name and identity are lost permanently. If circumstances render the goal impossible, the same fate applies. A division superior may issue a new identity, but proving who he is to file the paperwork presents its own challenge.

Scroll of Errata: The universal Arcane Fate (extending to Sidereals and fate-immune beings), the sorcerous Intimacy, the revised penalty structure (−2 on unrelated, −5 on contrary, +1 automatic success on goal-furthering rolls), and the stunt-reward healing replace the Core text's action prohibition and per-action healing mechanics.
